Geographies Served Programs Sustained Well-Being Services District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Swasth Foundation offers a range of sustained well-being services designed to empower individuals on their journey to holistic health. It provides personalized therapy and consultations to address specific aspects of well-being, ensuring tailored support for individuals. Additionally, the foundation conducts small group workshops that equip participants with the necessary knowledge, skills, and mindsets to achieve and maintain sustained well-being. Through these services, individuals gain access to a supportive community and receive guidance for their physical and energetic, mental and emotional, as well as spiritual and universal well-being. Health Coach Training Services District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Swasth Foundation offers health coach training services, empowering individuals to become certified coaches who harmonize body, energy, mind, emotions, intuition, and spirit. The training equips coaches to lead growth and change in various settings, impacting students, patients, professionals, and individuals seeking sustained well-being. Programmes include Sanjeevani, Foundations of Yogic Vichaar, Foundations of Yog & Yogic Vyaayaam, Yogic Practices, Saathi, and From Yoga to Yog. Coaches embody the principle of "Be the Change" and undergo a rigorous journey of self-transformation, unlocking their inner potential. Swasth Foundation envisions a world where individuals take charge of their well-being and enable others to live to their fullest potential. Comprehensive Primary Healthcare Services District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Swasth Foundation offers comprehensive primary healthcare services, providing diagnosis and treatment for both critical and regular illnesses. Its patient-centric team of professionals delivers high-quality healthcare services that are accessible and free of cost. Services include consultations and treatments with family physicians, as well as pathology lab services. For assistance and information, individuals can reach out to the foundation's helpline number or visit their branches. Additionally, an app is available for convenient access to healthcare services. Swasth Foundation is dedicated to ensuring that individuals receive the primary healthcare they need for their well-being.
